entities.summary: Chris James Redman is an American football coach and former quarterback who is the current head coach of the Louisville Kings of the United Football League (UFL). He played for nine seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Louisville Cardinals and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the third round of the 2000 NFL draft. Redman spent four seasons with the Ravens, primarily serving as a backup, and was part of the team that won a Super Bowl title in Super Bowl XXXV.
